newsitem.title: USA: NY business loans total $42.505 bln in Oct 2 week.
newsitem.headline: NY business loans total $42.505 bln in Oct 2 week.

text.p: Commercial and industrial loans at the six major New York banks, excluding acceptances, totaled $42.505 billion in the week ended October 2, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York said.
No net change in the loan data was available due to a change in the method of calculation by the Fed, a spokesman said. The net change will be available next week.
Including acceptances, loans totaled $42.766 billion. No net change was available in this data series either. The spokesman said the change would be available next week.
Commercial paper outstanding nationally rose $8.147 billion to $756.318 billion.
